system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Climate species endangerment war deflection",
    "detail": "Highlighting penguin and seal endangerment from climate change during war coverage suggests environmental crises deserve equivalent or greater attention than human conflict.",
    "debias": "Report environmental stories without implicit comparison to human conflict urgency.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-12",
    "status": "suggested",
    "detail_items": [
      "Highlighting penguin and seal endangerment from climate change during war coverage suggests environmental crises deserve equivalent or greater attention than human conflict."
    ]
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Document destruction conspiracy insinuation",
    "detail": "Reporting unverified accusations of document destruction as headline news before official response creates presumption of guilt.",
    "debias": "Wait for official responses before prominently featuring unverified accusations, or clearly label them as unconfirmed allegations.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-13",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Hungarian Prime Minister-elect Peter Magyar has accused outgoing Foreign Minister Péter Szijjártó of shredding confidential sanctions-related documents at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, citing insider sources during a press conference in Budapest on Monday. The ministry has not yet responded.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/13/peter-magyar-accuses-outgoing-foreign-minister-of-destroying-confidential-documents",
    "unbiased_text": "Hungarian Prime Minister-elect Peter Magyar has alleged, without providing evidence, that outgoing Foreign Minister Péter Szijjártó destroyed confidential sanctions-related documents. The ministry has not yet responded to the unverified claim."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Unpopularity ranking sensationalism",
    "detail": "Presenting survey results as definitive global rankings with superlatives like 'most unpopular in the world' without methodological context.",
    "debias": "Report survey findings with appropriate methodological caveats and avoid absolute superlatives.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-13",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Surveys show Friedrich Merz as the most unpopular leader across 24 democracies, far behind Narendra Modi, Lee Jae-myung and Andrej Babiš in approval.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/2026/04/13/german-chancellor-merz-the-most-unpopular-head-of-government-in-the-world-survey-shows",
    "unbiased_text": "According to surveys of 24 democracies, Friedrich Merz has lower approval ratings than leaders including Narendra Modi, Lee Jae-myung and Andrej Babiš."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Border collapse catastrophe extrapolation",
    "detail": "Projecting localized infrastructure failures into transnational catastrophe scenarios with borderless threat language.",
    "debias": "Report infrastructure risks with specific geographic scope rather than apocalyptic cross-border projections.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-14",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Failure to repair the protective structure around the nuclear site could unleash 'highly radioactive dust' that 'does not recognise borders', experts warn.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/2026/04/14/chernobyl-could-face-catastrophic-collapse-as-repairs-stall-following-russian-drone-strike",
    "unbiased_text": "Experts warn that failure to repair the protective structure could release radioactive material affecting the surrounding region."
  }
]
